column1: Supplemental Table S9: CellRank correlation scores for genes associated with pseudotime trajectories in human and ferret ductal lineages. Genes are categorized as Combined (scores >0.7 in both species), Human (>0.7 in human, <= 0.7 in ferret), or Ferret (>0.7 in ferret, <= 0.7 in human). Correlation scores range from -1 to 1 and represent the strength and direction of association between gene expression and pseudotime in each species.
